segments.tr: يمكن أن تستغرق التصاريح من 18 شهراً إلى خمس سنوات وقد تفشل ببساطة.

segments.src: The reward for surviving it: land that cost $40,000 an acre as pasture is worth several times that the day the zoning changes, before a single shovel moves.
segments.tr: المكافأة لتجاوزها: الأرض التي تكلف 40,000 دولار للفدان كمرعى تستحق عدة أضعاف ذلك يوم تغيير تقسيم المناطق، قبل تحريك أي حفار.

segments.src: **Type 2 — Redevelopment of an already-built site.** The dying mall, the vacant office tower, the aging strip center, the 1960s warehouse.
segments.tr: **النوع 2 — إعادة تطوير موقع مبني بالفعل.** مركز التسوق المحتضر، برج المكاتب الشاغر، مركز الشرائط القديم، مستودع الستينيات.

segments.src: Here the land already has infrastructure, roads, and usually decent zoning — which is exactly why the site is expensive.
segments.tr: هنا تمتلك الأرض بالفعل بنية تحتية وطرقاً وعادة ما تكون لها تقسيم مناطق جيد — وهذا بالضبط السبب في أن الموقع مكلف.

segments.src: You're buying a building you may not want, so demolition, asbestos abatement, and environmental cleanup enter the budget.
segments.tr: أنت تشتري مبنى قد لا تريده، لذا يدخل الهدم وإزالة الأسبستوس والتنظيف البيئي في الميزانية.

segments.src: Two sub-flavors matter: **teardown-and-rebuild** (raze it, densify it) and **adaptive reuse** (keep the bones, change the use — a warehouse becomes lofts, a mall becomes a town center).
segments.tr: يهم نوعان فرعيان: **الهدم وإعادة البناء** (مسحه وزيادة كثافته) و**إعادة الاستخدام** (احفظ الهيكل الأساسي، غيّر الاستخدام — يصبح المستودع شقق، مركز التسوق يصبح مركز البلدة).

segments.src: Redevelopment also carries a political cost the greenfield deal doesn't: existing tenants, existing neighbors, existing memories.
segments.tr: تحمل إعادة التطوير أيضاً تكلفة سياسية لا يحملها العقد الأخضر: المستأجرون الموجودون، الجيران الموجودون، الذكريات الموجودة.

segments.src: **Type 3 isn't a place — it's a structure.** This is where most beginners get lost.
segments.tr: **النوع 3 ليس مكاناً — إنه هيكل.** هنا يضيع معظم المبتدئين.

segments.src: *Project finance* means the deal is underwritten against the project's own future cash flow and value, not the developer's balance sheet.
segments.tr: *تمويل المشروع* يعني أن الصفقة مؤمّنة ضد التدفق النقدي المستقبلي والقيمة الخاصة بالمشروع، وليس ميزانية المطور العمومية.

segments.src: It's usually held in a single-purpose entity (an LLC that owns exactly one thing), so a failure is walled off from the sponsor's other deals.
segments.tr: يتم عادة الاحتفاظ به في كيان ذو غرض واحد (شركة ذات مسؤولية محدودة تمتلك شيئاً واحداً بالضبط)، لذا فإن الفشل معزول عن صفقات الراعي الأخرى.

segments.src: The money arrives in layers — the **capital stack**:
segments.tr: يأتي المال في طبقات — **هيكل رأس المال**:

segments.src: Common equity      (sponsor + investors)  — last paid, highest upside
segments.tr: Common equity      (sponsor + investors)  — last paid, highest upside

segments.src: Preferred / mezz   (11–15% typical)       — fills the gap
segments.tr: Preferred / mezz   (11–15% typical)       — fills the gap

segments.src: Construction loan  (55–65% of cost)       — cheapest, paid first
segments.tr: Construction loan  (55–65% of cost)       — cheapest, paid first

segments.src: The construction loan is the piece people misunderstand most.
segments.tr: قرض البناء هو الجزء الذي يسيء الناس فهمه أكثر.

segments.src: You don't get a check at closing.
segments.tr: لا تحصل على شيك عند الإغلاق.

segments.src: You get a *commitment*, and you draw against it monthly as work is verified — with an interest reserve baked in, because there's no rent yet to pay interest with.
segments.tr: تحصل على *التزام*، وتسحب منه شهرياً عند التحقق من العمل — مع احتياطي فائدة مدمج، لأنه لا توجد إيجارات حتى الآن لدفع الفائدة منها.

segments.src: It's short (24–36 months), floating-rate, and it must be replaced at the end by a **takeout** (permanent) loan or a sale.
segments.tr: إنه قصير الأجل (24–36 شهراً)، بسعر عائم، ويجب أن يتم استبداله في النهاية برصيد **دائم** أو بيع.

segments.src: That refinancing moment is where a lot of otherwise fine projects died in 2023–2024: costs and rates had moved, and the takeout wouldn't cover the construction loan.
segments.tr: لحظة إعادة التمويل هذه هي حيث مات الكثير من المشاريع الجيدة بخلاف ذلك في 2023–2024: تحركت التكاليف والأسعار، والرصيد الدائم لم يكن يغطي قرض البناء.

segments.src: The number that ties all three together is **yield on cost**: stabilized annual net operating income divided by total project cost.
segments.tr: الرقم الذي يربط الثلاثة معاً هو **العائد على التكلفة**: صافي دخل التشغيل السنوي المستقر مقسوماً على إجمالي تكلفة المشروع.

segments.src: Developers compare it to the cap rate that finished buildings trade at.
segments.tr: يقارن المطورون ذلك بمعدل الرسملة الذي تتداول به المباني المكتملة.

segments.src: If you build to a 6.5% yield on cost in a market where stabilized assets sell at a 5.25% cap rate, that ~125 basis point spread *is* the development profit.
segments.tr: إذا قمت ببناء بعائد 6.5% على التكلفة في سوق حيث تُباع الأصول المستقرة بمعدل رسملة 5.25%، فإن هذا الفارق من حوالي 125 نقطة أساس *هو* ربح التطوير.

segments.src: If the spread compresses to zero, the rational move is to buy an existing building instead of building one.
segments.tr: إذا انضغط الفارق إلى الصفر، فإن الخطوة المنطقية هي شراء مبنى موجود بدلاً من بناء واحد جديد.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## في الحياة اليومية

segments.src: Picture a 1972 enclosed mall on 28 acres in a suburb outside Columbus.
segments.tr: تخيل مركز تسوق مغلق من عام 1972 على 28 فدان في ضاحية خارج كولومبوس.

segments.src: Anchor gone, occupancy under 40%, assessed value falling every year — which the city notices, because that's a shrinking tax line.
segments.tr: المحل الرئيسي ذهب، الإشغال أقل من 40%، القيمة المقيمة تنخفض كل سنة — وهو ما تلاحظه المدينة، لأن هذا عنوان ضريبي متقلص.

segments.src: A developer options the site for $18 million.
segments.tr: يتخذ المطور خيار على الموقع مقابل 18 مليون دولار.

segments.src: That's Type 2: redevelopment.
segments.tr: ذلك هو النوع 2: إعادة التطوير.

segments.src: The mall's zoning allows retail but not apartments, so step one is entitlement — a rezoning to mixed use, which takes 14 months and three contentious council meetings.
segments.tr: تقسيم المناطق في مركز التسوق يسمح بالتجزئة لكن ليس الشقق، لذا الخطوة الأولى هي التصاريح — إعادة تقسيم المناطق لاستخدام مختلط، والتي تستغرق 14 شهراً وثلاث اجتماعات مجلس متنازع عليها.

segments.src: Demolition and site prep run $6 million before anything is built.
segments.tr: يبلغ الهدم وتحضير الموقع 6 ملايين دولار قبل بناء أي شيء.

segments.src: Total cost pencils at roughly $70 million for 340 apartments plus 40,000 square feet of ground-floor retail.
segments.tr: يقدر إجمالي التكلفة بحوالي 70 مليون دولار لـ 340 شقة بالإضافة إلى 40,000 قدم مربع من التجزئة بالدور الأرضي.

segments.src: The capital stack: a $42 million construction loan at 60% loan-to-cost drawn monthly, $12 million of preferred equity, $16 million of common equity from the sponsor and a handful of LPs.
segments.tr: هيكل رأس المال: قرض بناء بقيمة 42 مليون دولار بنسبة 60% قرض إلى التكلفة يتم سحبه شهرياً، 12 مليون دولار من الأسهم الممتازة، 16 مليون دولار من الأسهم العادية من الراعي وعدد قليل من الشركاء المحدودين.

segments.src: The gap is the public infrastructure — new streets, stormwater, a realigned intersection, roughly $9 million of work no lender wants to finance because it produces no rent.
segments.tr: الفجوة هي البنية التحتية العامة — شوارع جديدة، مياه العواصف، تقاطع أعيد محاذاته، حوالي 9 ملايين دولار من العمل لا يريد أي مُقرِض أن يمولها لأنها لا تنتج أي إيجار.

segments.src: So the city creates a **TIF district**: property taxes on the site are frozen at today's depressed level for the taxing bodies, and the *increment* above that — the new taxes generated because the project exists — repays bonds that fund the infrastructure.
segments.tr: لذا تنشئ المدينة **منطقة تمويل الزيادة الضريبية**: الضرائب على الممتلكات في الموقع مجمدة على المستوى المنخفض الحالي للهيئات الضريبية، والـ *زيادة* فوق ذلك — الضرائب الجديدة الناتجة لأن المشروع موجود — تسدد السندات التي تمول البنية التحتية.

segments.src: The city risks future revenue it wouldn't have had otherwise; the developer gets the roads.
segments.tr: تخاطر المدينة بإيرادات مستقبلية ما كانت ستحصل عليها بخلاف ذلك؛ المطور يحصل على الطرق.

segments.src: (This is a real trade-off, not free money: if the increment underperforms, someone is on the hook, and school districts often object because their share is frozen too.)
segments.tr: (هذا مقابل حقيقي، وليس أموالاً مجانية: إذا كانت الزيادة أقل من الأداء، فإن شخصاً ما مسؤول، وغالباً ما تعترض مناطق المدارس لأن حصتها مجمدة أيضاً.)

segments.src: Three years later, stabilized NOI is $4.6 million on $70 million of cost — a 6.6% yield on cost.
segments.tr: بعد ثلاث سنوات، صافي دخل التشغيل المستقر هو 4.6 ملايين دولار على 70 مليون دولار من التكلفة — عائد 6.6% على التكلفة.

segments.src: Comparable stabilized apartments in that submarket trade near a 5.4% cap rate, implying a value around $85 million.
segments.tr: الشقق المستقرة المقارنة في تلك السوق الفرعية يتم تداولها بالقرب من معدل رسملة 5.4%، مما يعني قيمة حوالي 85 مليون دولار.

segments.src: The construction loan is retired with a permanent loan, and the spread between $85 million and $70 million is the return that compensated everyone for four years of risk.
segments.tr: يتم التقاعد من قرض البناء برصيد دائم، والفارق بين 85 مليون دولار و 70 مليون دولار هو العائد الذي عوّض الجميع على أربع سنوات من المخاطر.

segments.src: Change one input — construction costs up 12%, or rates up 150 basis points — and that spread vanishes.
segments.tr: غيّر مدخلاً واحداً — تكاليف البناء بنسبة 12%، أو الأسعار بمقدار 150 نقطة أساس — والفارق يختفي.

segments.src: That's why so many announced projects never break ground.
segments.tr: هذا هو السبب في أن العديد من المشاريع المعلنة لا تبدأ أبداً.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## ملخص من 3 أسطر

segments.src: 1. Development sites come in two kinds: raw land (where entitlement risk dominates) and already-built sites (where acquisition cost, demolition, and politics dominate).
segments.tr: 1. تأتي مواقع التطوير بنوعين: أراضٍ خام (حيث يهيمن خطر التصاريح) ومواقع مبنية بالفعل (حيث يهيمن تكلفة الاستحواذ والهدم والسياسة).

segments.src: 2. Project finance is the engine — a single-purpose entity, a layered capital stack, and a draw-based construction loan that must be replaced by a takeout loan or a sale.
segments.tr: 2. تمويل المشروع هو المحرك — كيان ذو غرض واحد، هيكل رأس مال متعدد الطبقات، وقرض بناء مستند إلى السحب والذي يجب استبداله برصيد دائم أو بيع.

segments.src: 3. The deal only works if yield on cost clears the market cap rate by a meaningful spread; when that spread compresses, building stops even where demand is obvious.
segments.tr: 3. الصفقة تعمل فقط إذا كان العائد على التكلفة يتجاوز معدل رسملة السوق بفارق ذي مغزى؛ عندما ينضغط هذا الفارق، يتوقف البناء حتى حيث يكون الطلب واضحاً.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ اختبار ذاتي

segments.src: (O/X)** A construction loan is funded in full at closing, and the developer holds the cash until it's needed.
segments.tr: (صحيح/خطأ)** يتم تمويل قرض البناء بالكامل عند الإغلاق، والمطور يحتفظ بالنقود حتى الحاجة إليها.

segments.src: **2.** "Entitlement" in development most nearly means:
segments.tr: **2.** "التصاريح" في التطوير تعني الأقرب:

segments.src: - (a) Signing the purchase contract for the land
segments.tr: - (أ) توقيع عقد شراء الأرض

segments.src: - (b) Securing the legal right to build the use and density you want
segments.tr: - (ب) تأمين الحق القانوني في بناء الاستخدام والكثافة التي تريدها

segments.src: - (c) Hiring the general contractor
segments.tr: - (ج) توظيف المقاول العام

segments.src: - (d) Locking the permanent loan rate
segments.tr: - (د) تثبيت معدل الرصيد الدائم

segments.src: **3.** A project underwrites to a 6.5% yield on cost, while similar finished buildings in that market trade at a 5.25% cap rate.
segments.tr: **3.** يتم التأمين على مشروع بعائد 6.5% على التكلفة، بينما تتداول المباني المكتملة المماثلة في تلك السوق بمعدل رسملة 5.25%.

segments.src: This gap primarily represents:
segments.tr: يمثل هذا الفارق في المقام الأول:

segments.src: - (a) The developer's compensation for taking construction and lease-up risk
segments.tr: - (أ) تعويض المطور عن تحمل مخاطر البناء والتأجير

segments.src: - (b) The interest rate on the construction loan
segments.tr: - (ب) سعر الفائدة على قرض البناء

segments.src: - (c) The property tax rate
segments.tr: - (ج) معدل ضريبة الممتلكات

segments.src: - (d) An error — the two numbers should always match
segments.tr: - (د) خطأ — يجب أن تتطابق الأرقام الاثنان دائماً

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 شروط اليوم

segments.src: - **Entitlement** — The bundle of government approvals (zoning, site plan, permits) that make a specific project legally buildable on a specific site.
segments.tr: - **التصاريح** — مجموعة الموافقات الحكومية (تقسيم المناطق، خطة الموقع، الرخص) التي تجعل مشروعاً معيناً قابلاً للبناء قانوناً على موقع معين.

segments.src: - **Capital stack** — The layered ordering of money in a deal, from senior debt (paid first, lowest return) up to common equity (paid last, highest upside).
segments.tr: - **هيكل رأس المال** — الترتيب المتعدد الطبقات للأموال في الصفقة، من الديون الأقدمية (يتم الدفع أولاً، أقل عائد) إلى الأسهم العادية (يتم الدفع أخيراً، أعلى ارتفاع).

segments.src: - **Loan-to-cost (LTC)** — Construction loan amount divided by total project cost; the lender's measure of how much of the budget it's funding, typically 55–65% in recent years.
segments.tr: - **نسبة القرض إلى التكلفة (LTC)** — مبلغ قرض البناء مقسوماً على إجمالي تكلفة المشروع؛ مقياس المُقرِض لمقدار الميزانية التي يمولها، عادة 55–65% في السنوات الأخيرة.

segments.src: - **Yield on cost** — Stabilized net operating income divided by total project cost; compared against market cap rates to judge whether building beats buying.
segments.tr: - **العائد على التكلفة** — صافي دخل التشغيل المستقر مقسوماً على إجمالي تكلفة المشروع؛ مقارن مع معدلات رسملة السوق للحكم ما إذا كان البناء أفضل من الشراء.

segments.src: - **Tax increment financing (TIF)** — A public tool that funds project infrastructure by pledging the *future increase* in property tax revenue the project itself is expected to generate.
segments.tr: - **تمويل الزيادة الضريبية (TIF)** — أداة عامة تمول البنية التحتية للمشروع من خلال الرهن على *الزيادة المستقبلية* في إيرادات ضريبة الممتلكات التي يتوقع أن ينتجها المشروع نفسه.

segments.src: *Answers: 1 — X (False).
segments.tr: *الإجابات: 1 — خطأ (غير صحيح).

segments.src: Construction loans are drawn in stages as completed work is inspected and verified, which is why an interest reserve is built into the budget.
segments.tr: يتم سحب قروض البناء على مراحل عند التحقق من العمل المكتمل والتحقق منه، وهذا هو السبب في بناء احتياطي الفائدة في الميزانية.

segments.src: Entitlement is the legal right to build, and it is usually the single riskiest and least controllable phase of a ground-up deal.
segments.tr: التصاريح هي الحق القانوني في البناء، وهي عادة المرحلة الأخطر والأقل قابلية للسيطرة في صفقة من الأساس.

segments.src: That roughly 125 basis point gap is the development spread: the extra return earned for building an asset rather than buying a finished one.
segments.tr: هذا الفارق من حوالي 125 نقطة أساس هو فارق التطوير: العائد الإضافي المكتسب لبناء أصل بدلاً من شراء أصل مكتمل.

segments.src: When it compresses toward zero, projects stop penciling.*
segments.tr: عندما ينضغط نحو الصفر، تتوقف المشاريع عن أن تصبح مجدية.*

fr.title: [Real Estate 101 #8] Le centre commercial décédé au bout de la rue est une énigme de 70 millions de dollars — Voici comment les promoteurs la résolvent

segments.src: > Development deals come in two flavors by *where* they happen — raw land or an already-built site — and one financing engine that decides whether either flavor ever gets out of the ground.
segments.tr: > Les opérations immobilières se divisent en deux catégories selon *où* elles se produisent — terrain brut ou site déjà construit — et un seul moteur de financement qui détermine si l'une ou l'autre catégorie sort jamais de terre.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Le concept d'aujourd'hui

segments.src: When people say "a developer built that," they're compressing three very different jobs into one verb.
segments.tr: Quand les gens disent « un promoteur a construit cela », ils compriment trois métiers très différents en un seul verbe.

segments.src: **Type 1 — Ground-up on raw or unimproved land.** A farm field at the edge of a growing metro becomes 600 homes, a spine road, sewer lines, and a retail pad.
segments.tr: **Type 1 — Construction depuis zéro sur terrain brut ou non aménagé.** Un champ agricole à la lisière d'une métropole en expansion devient 600 habitations, une route colonne vertébrale, des conduites d'égout et un pad commercial.

segments.src: The technical name is *land development* or *master-planned* development.
segments.tr: Le nom technique est *aménagement foncier* ou développement *planifié au master*.

segments.src: The hard part isn't construction; it's **entitlement** — the legal right to build what you want.
segments.tr: La partie difficile n'est pas la construction ; c'est le **droit de construire** — le droit légal de construire ce que vous voulez.

segments.src: Rezoning, site plan approval, traffic studies, environmental review, and a string of public hearings where neighbors show up.
segments.tr: Changement de zonage, approbation du plan du site, études de circulation, examen environnemental et une série d'audiences publiques où les voisins se présentent.

segments.src: Entitlement can take 18 months to five years and can simply fail.
segments.tr: Le droit de construire peut prendre 18 mois à cinq ans et peut simplement échouer.

segments.src: The reward for surviving it: land that cost $40,000 an acre as pasture is worth several times that the day the zoning changes, before a single shovel moves.
segments.tr: La récompense pour l'avoir survécu : un terrain qui coûtait 40 000 $ l'acre comme pâturage vaut plusieurs fois cela le jour où le zonage change, avant qu'une seule pelle ne bouge.

segments.src: **Type 2 — Redevelopment of an already-built site.** The dying mall, the vacant office tower, the aging strip center, the 1960s warehouse.
segments.tr: **Type 2 — Réaménagement d'un site déjà construit.** Le centre commercial mourant, la tour de bureaux vide, le vieux centre commercial linéaire, l'entrepôt des années 1960.

segments.src: Here the land already has infrastructure, roads, and usually decent zoning — which is exactly why the site is expensive.
segments.tr: Ici, le terrain a déjà une infrastructure, des routes et généralement un bon zonage — ce qui est exactement pourquoi le site est cher.

segments.src: You're buying a building you may not want, so demolition, asbestos abatement, and environmental cleanup enter the budget.
segments.tr: Vous achetez un bâtiment que vous ne voudrez peut-être pas, donc la démolition, l'enlèvement de l'amiante et le nettoyage environnemental entrent dans le budget.

segments.src: Two sub-flavors matter: **teardown-and-rebuild** (raze it, densify it) and **adaptive reuse** (keep the bones, change the use — a warehouse becomes lofts, a mall becomes a town center).
segments.tr: Deux sous-catégories sont importantes : **démolition-et-reconstruction** (la raser, la densifier) et **réutilisation adaptative** (conserver la structure, changer l'usage — un entrepôt devient des lofts, un centre commercial devient un centre-ville).

segments.src: Redevelopment also carries a political cost the greenfield deal doesn't: existing tenants, existing neighbors, existing memories.
segments.tr: Le réaménagement porte aussi un coût politique que l'opération sur greenfield n'a pas : les locataires existants, les voisins existants, les souvenirs existants.

segments.src: **Type 3 isn't a place — it's a structure.** This is where most beginners get lost.
segments.tr: **Le type 3 n'est pas un endroit — c'est une structure.** C'est là que la plupart des débutants se perdent.

segments.src: *Project finance* means the deal is underwritten against the project's own future cash flow and value, not the developer's balance sheet.
segments.tr: *Le financement de projet* signifie que l'opération est souscrite en fonction des flux de trésorerie et de la valeur future propre du projet, et non du bilan du promoteur.

segments.src: It's usually held in a single-purpose entity (an LLC that owns exactly one thing), so a failure is walled off from the sponsor's other deals.
segments.tr: Elle est généralement détenue dans une entité à usage unique (une SARL qui possède exactement une chose), de sorte qu'un échec est isolé des autres opérations du parrain.

segments.src: The money arrives in layers — the **capital stack**:
segments.tr: L'argent arrive par couches — la **pile de capital**:

segments.src: Common equity      (sponsor + investors)  — last paid, highest upside
segments.tr: Common equity      (sponsor + investors)  — last paid, highest upside

segments.src: Preferred / mezz   (11–15% typical)       — fills the gap
segments.tr: Preferred / mezz   (11–15% typical)       — fills the gap

segments.src: Construction loan  (55–65% of cost)       — cheapest, paid first
segments.tr: Construction loan  (55–65% of cost)       — cheapest, paid first

segments.src: The construction loan is the piece people misunderstand most.
segments.tr: Le prêt à la construction est la pièce que les gens comprennent le moins bien.

segments.src: You don't get a check at closing.
segments.tr: Vous ne recevez pas de chèque à la clôture.

segments.src: You get a *commitment*, and you draw against it monthly as work is verified — with an interest reserve baked in, because there's no rent yet to pay interest with.
segments.tr: Vous obtenez un *engagement*, et vous tirez dessus mensuellement au fur et à mesure que le travail est vérifié — avec une réserve d'intérêts intégrée, car il n'y a pas encore de loyer pour payer les intérêts.

segments.src: It's short (24–36 months), floating-rate, and it must be replaced at the end by a **takeout** (permanent) loan or a sale.
segments.tr: C'est court (24–36 mois), à taux variable, et il doit être remplacé à la fin par un prêt **de financement permanent** ou une vente.

segments.src: That refinancing moment is where a lot of otherwise fine projects died in 2023–2024: costs and rates had moved, and the takeout wouldn't cover the construction loan.
segments.tr: Ce moment de refinancement est l'endroit où beaucoup de projets par ailleurs corrects ont échoué en 2023–2024 : les coûts et les taux avaient changé, et le financement permanent ne couvrait pas le prêt à la construction.

segments.src: The number that ties all three together is **yield on cost**: stabilized annual net operating income divided by total project cost.
segments.tr: Le nombre qui lie tous les trois ensemble est **le rendement du coût** : le revenu net d'exploitation annuel stabilisé divisé par le coût total du projet.

segments.src: Developers compare it to the cap rate that finished buildings trade at.
segments.tr: Les promoteurs le comparent au taux de capitalisation auquel les bâtiments finis se négocient.

segments.src: If you build to a 6.5% yield on cost in a market where stabilized assets sell at a 5.25% cap rate, that ~125 basis point spread *is* the development profit.
segments.tr: Si vous construisez avec un rendement du coût de 6,5 % sur un marché où les actifs stabilisés se vendent à un taux de capitalisation de 5,25 %, cet écart d'environ 125 points de base *est* le bénéfice de développement.

segments.src: If the spread compresses to zero, the rational move is to buy an existing building instead of building one.
segments.tr: Si l'écart se comprime à zéro, le mouvement rationnel est d'acheter un bâtiment existant au lieu d'en construire un.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dans la vie de tous les jours

segments.src: Picture a 1972 enclosed mall on 28 acres in a suburb outside Columbus.
segments.tr: Imaginez un centre commercial fermé de 1972 sur 28 acres dans une banlieue à l'extérieur de Columbus.

segments.src: Anchor gone, occupancy under 40%, assessed value falling every year — which the city notices, because that's a shrinking tax line.
segments.tr: Ancre disparue, occupation inférieure à 40 %, valeur estimée chutant chaque année — ce que la ville remarque, car c'est une ligne fiscale décroissante.

segments.src: A developer options the site for $18 million.
segments.tr: Un promoteur acquiert le droit d'option sur le site pour 18 millions de dollars.

segments.src: That's Type 2: redevelopment.
segments.tr: C'est le type 2 : réaménagement.

segments.src: The mall's zoning allows retail but not apartments, so step one is entitlement — a rezoning to mixed use, which takes 14 months and three contentious council meetings.
segments.tr: Le zonage du centre commercial permet le commerce de détail mais pas les appartements, donc la première étape est le droit de construire — un changement de zonage à usage mixte, qui prend 14 mois et trois réunions conflictuelles du conseil.

segments.src: Demolition and site prep run $6 million before anything is built.
segments.tr: La démolition et la préparation du site coûtent 6 millions de dollars avant que quoi que ce soit soit construit.

segments.src: Total cost pencils at roughly $70 million for 340 apartments plus 40,000 square feet of ground-floor retail.
segments.tr: Le coût total s'élève à environ 70 millions de dollars pour 340 appartements plus 40 000 pieds carrés de commerce au rez-de-chaussée.

segments.src: The capital stack: a $42 million construction loan at 60% loan-to-cost drawn monthly, $12 million of preferred equity, $16 million of common equity from the sponsor and a handful of LPs.
segments.tr: La pile de capital : un prêt à la construction de 42 millions de dollars à 60 % du financement du coût tiré mensuellement, 12 millions de dollars de capital privilégié, 16 millions de dollars de capital ordinaire du parrain et une poignée de LP.

segments.src: The gap is the public infrastructure — new streets, stormwater, a realigned intersection, roughly $9 million of work no lender wants to finance because it produces no rent.
segments.tr: L'écart est l'infrastructure publique — les routes nouvelles, les eaux pluviales, une intersection réalignée, environ 9 millions de dollars de travail qu'aucun prêteur ne veut financer car il ne produit pas de loyer.

segments.src: So the city creates a **TIF district**: property taxes on the site are frozen at today's depressed level for the taxing bodies, and the *increment* above that — the new taxes generated because the project exists — repays bonds that fund the infrastructure.
segments.tr: Ainsi, la ville crée un **district TIF** : les impôts fonciers sur le site sont gelés au niveau actuel déprimé pour les organismes fiscaux, et l'*incrément* au-dessus — les nouvelles taxes générées parce que le projet existe — rembourse les obligations qui financent l'infrastructure.

segments.src: The city risks future revenue it wouldn't have had otherwise; the developer gets the roads.
segments.tr: La ville risque des revenus futurs qu'elle n'aurait pas eus autrement ; le promoteur obtient les routes.

segments.src: (This is a real trade-off, not free money: if the increment underperforms, someone is on the hook, and school districts often object because their share is frozen too.)
segments.tr: (C'est un vrai compromis, pas de l'argent gratuit : si l'incrément sous-performe, quelqu'un est responsable, et les districts scolaires s'opposent souvent car leur part est aussi gelée.)

segments.src: Three years later, stabilized NOI is $4.6 million on $70 million of cost — a 6.6% yield on cost.
segments.tr: Trois ans plus tard, le NOI stabilisé est de 4,6 millions de dollars sur 70 millions de dollars de coût — un rendement du coût de 6,6 %.

segments.src: Comparable stabilized apartments in that submarket trade near a 5.4% cap rate, implying a value around $85 million.
segments.tr: Les appartements stabilisés comparables dans ce sous-marché se négocient près d'un taux de capitalisation de 5,4 %, impliquant une valeur d'environ 85 millions de dollars.

segments.src: The construction loan is retired with a permanent loan, and the spread between $85 million and $70 million is the return that compensated everyone for four years of risk.
segments.tr: Le prêt à la construction est retiré avec un prêt permanent, et l'écart entre 85 millions de dollars et 70 millions de dollars est le rendement qui a compensé tout le monde pour quatre ans de risque.

segments.src: Change one input — construction costs up 12%, or rates up 150 basis points — and that spread vanishes.
segments.tr: Changez une entrée — les coûts de construction augmentent de 12 %, ou les taux augmentent de 150 points de base — et cet écart disparaît.

segments.src: That's why so many announced projects never break ground.
segments.tr: C'est pourquoi tellement de projets annoncés ne voient jamais le jour.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Récapitulatif en 3 lignes

segments.src: 1. Development sites come in two kinds: raw land (where entitlement risk dominates) and already-built sites (where acquisition cost, demolition, and politics dominate).
segments.tr: 1. Les sites de développement se divisent en deux types : les terrains bruts (où le risque de droit de construire domine) et les sites déjà construits (où le coût d'acquisition, la démolition et la politique dominent).

segments.src: 2. Project finance is the engine — a single-purpose entity, a layered capital stack, and a draw-based construction loan that must be replaced by a takeout loan or a sale.
segments.tr: 2. Le financement de projet est le moteur — une entité à usage unique, une pile de capital en couches, et un prêt à la construction basé sur les tirages qui doit être remplacé par un prêt de financement permanent ou une vente.

segments.src: 3. The deal only works if yield on cost clears the market cap rate by a meaningful spread; when that spread compresses, building stops even where demand is obvious.
segments.tr: 3. L'opération ne fonctionne que si le rendement du coût dépasse le taux de capitalisation du marché par un écart significatif ; quand cet écart se comprime, la construction s'arrête même où la demande est évidente.

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Les termes d'aujourd'hui

segments.src: - **Entitlement** — The bundle of government approvals (zoning, site plan, permits) that make a specific project legally buildable on a specific site.
segments.tr: - **Droit de construire** — L'ensemble des approbations gouvernementales (zonage, plan du site, permis) qui rendent un projet spécifique légalement constructible sur un site spécifique.

segments.src: - **Capital stack** — The layered ordering of money in a deal, from senior debt (paid first, lowest return) up to common equity (paid last, highest upside).
segments.tr: - **Pile de capital** — L'ordonnancement en couches de l'argent dans une opération, de la dette senior (payée en premier, rendement le plus faible) au capital ordinaire (payé en dernier, plus-value la plus élevée).

segments.src: - **Loan-to-cost (LTC)** — Construction loan amount divided by total project cost; the lender's measure of how much of the budget it's funding, typically 55–65% in recent years.
segments.tr: - **Financement du coût (LTC)** — Montant du prêt à la construction divisé par le coût total du projet ; la mesure du prêteur du montant du budget qu'il finance, généralement 55–65 % ces dernières années.

segments.src: - **Yield on cost** — Stabilized net operating income divided by total project cost; compared against market cap rates to judge whether building beats buying.
segments.tr: - **Rendement du coût** — Revenu net d'exploitation stabilisé divisé par le coût total du projet ; comparé aux taux de capitalisation du marché pour juger si la construction est meilleure que l'achat.

segments.src: - **Tax increment financing (TIF)** — A public tool that funds project infrastructure by pledging the *future increase* in property tax revenue the project itself is expected to generate.
segments.tr: - **Financement par incrément fiscal (TIF)** — Un outil public qui finance l'infrastructure du projet en engageant l'*augmentation future* des revenus d'impôt foncier que le projet lui-même est censé générer.

segments.tr: ## O Conceito de Hoje

segments.src: When people say "a developer built that," they're compressing three very different jobs into one verb.
segments.tr: Quando as pessoas dizem "um desenvolvedor construiu aquilo", elas estão comprimindo três trabalhos muito diferentes em um verbo.

segments.src: **Type 1 — Ground-up on raw or unimproved land.** A farm field at the edge of a growing metro becomes 600 homes, a spine road, sewer lines, and a retail pad.
segments.tr: **Tipo 1 — Do zero em terra bruta ou não melhorada.** Um campo de fazenda na borda de uma metrópole em crescimento se torna 600 casas, uma via espinha dorsal, linhas de esgoto e um espaço de varejo.

segments.src: The technical name is *land development* or *master-planned* development.
segments.tr: O nome técnico é *desenvolvimento de terra* ou desenvolvimento *planejado*.

segments.src: The hard part isn't construction; it's **entitlement** — the legal right to build what you want.
segments.tr: A parte difícil não é a construção; é **direito de construir** — o direito legal de construir o que você quer.

segments.src: Rezoning, site plan approval, traffic studies, environmental review, and a string of public hearings where neighbors show up.
segments.tr: Rezoneamento, aprovação do plano do local, estudos de tráfego, revisão ambiental e uma série de audiências públicas onde os vizinhos comparecem.

segments.src: Entitlement can take 18 months to five years and can simply fail.
segments.tr: O direito de construir pode levar 18 meses a cinco anos e pode simplesmente falhar.

segments.src: The reward for surviving it: land that cost $40,000 an acre as pasture is worth several times that the day the zoning changes, before a single shovel moves.
segments.tr: A recompensa por sobreviver a isso: terra que custava $40,000 por acre como pasto vale várias vezes mais no dia em que a zona muda, antes de uma única pá se mover.

segments.src: **Type 2 — Redevelopment of an already-built site.** The dying mall, the vacant office tower, the aging strip center, the 1960s warehouse.
segments.tr: **Tipo 2 — Redesenvolvimento de um local já construído.** O shopping em declínio, a torre de escritórios vazia, o centro comercial envelhecido, o depósito dos anos 1960.

segments.src: Here the land already has infrastructure, roads, and usually decent zoning — which is exactly why the site is expensive.
segments.tr: Aqui o terreno já possui infraestrutura, estradas e geralmente zoneamento decente — que é exatamente por que o local é caro.

segments.src: You're buying a building you may not want, so demolition, asbestos abatement, and environmental cleanup enter the budget.

segments.tr: Assim, a cidade cria um **distrito TIF**: impostos sobre a propriedade no local são congelados no nível deprimido de hoje para os órgãos arrecadadores de impostos, e o *incremento* acima disso — os novos impostos gerados porque o projeto existe — repagam os títulos que financiam a infraestrutura.

segments.src: The city risks future revenue it wouldn't have had otherwise; the developer gets the roads.
segments.tr: A cidade arrisca receita futura que não teria tido de outra forma; o desenvolvedor obtém as estradas.

segments.src: (This is a real trade-off, not free money: if the increment underperforms, someone is on the hook, and school districts often object because their share is frozen too.)
segments.tr: (Esta é uma compensação real, não dinheiro gratuito: se o incremento tiver desempenho inferior, alguém fica no gancho, e os distritos escolares frequentemente se opõem porque sua parte também é congelada.)

segments.src: Three years later, stabilized NOI is $4.6 million on $70 million of cost — a 6.6% yield on cost.
segments.tr: Três anos depois, a renda operacional líquida estabilizada é $4.6 milhões em $70 milhões de custo — um retorno sobre custo de 6.6%.

segments.src: Comparable stabilized apartments in that submarket trade near a 5.4% cap rate, implying a value around $85 million.
segments.tr: Apartamentos estabilizados comparáveis naquele submercado são negociados perto de uma taxa de capitalização de 5.4%, implicando um valor em torno de $85 milhões.

segments.src: The construction loan is retired with a permanent loan, and the spread between $85 million and $70 million is the return that compensated everyone for four years of risk.
segments.tr: O empréstimo de construção é retirado com um empréstimo permanente, e o spread entre $85 milhões e $70 milhões é o retorno que compensou todos por quatro anos de risco.

segments.src: Change one input — construction costs up 12%, or rates up 150 basis points — and that spread vanishes.
segments.tr: Mude uma entrada — custos de construção acima de 12%, ou taxas acima de 150 pontos base — e esse spread desaparece.

segments.src: That's why so many announced projects never break ground.
segments.tr: É por isso que tantos projetos anunciados nunca começam.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## Resumo de 3 Linhas

segments.src: 1. Development sites come in two kinds: raw land (where entitlement risk dominates) and already-built sites (where acquisition cost, demolition, and politics dominate).
segments.tr: 1. Os locais de desenvolvimento vêm em dois tipos: terra bruta (onde o risco do direito de construir domina) e locais já construídos (onde o custo de aquisição, demolição e política dominam).

segments.src: 2. Project finance is the engine — a single-purpose entity, a layered capital stack, and a draw-based construction loan that must be replaced by a takeout loan or a sale.
segments.tr: 2. O financiamento de projeto é o motor — uma entidade de propósito único, uma estrutura de capital em camadas e um empréstimo de construção baseado em saque que deve ser substituído por um empréstimo de refinanciamento ou uma venda.

segments.src: 3. The deal only works if yield on cost clears the market cap rate by a meaningful spread; when that spread compresses, building stops even where demand is obvious.
segments.tr: 3. O negócio funciona apenas se o retorno sobre custo ultrapassa a taxa de capitalização do mercado por um spread significativo; quando esse spread se comprime, a construção para mesmo onde a demanda é óbvia.

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Termos de Hoje

segments.src: - **Entitlement** — The bundle of government approvals (zoning, site plan, permits) that make a specific project legally buildable on a specific site.
segments.tr: - **Direito de construir** — O conjunto de aprovações governamentais (zoneamento, plano do local, permissões) que tornam um projeto específico legalmente construível em um local específico.

segments.src: - **Capital stack** — The layered ordering of money in a deal, from senior debt (paid first, lowest return) up to common equity (paid last, highest upside).
segments.tr: - **Estrutura de capital** — A ordenação em camadas do dinheiro em um negócio, de dívida sênior (paga primeiro, retorno mais baixo) até patrimônio comum (pago por último, maior retorno).

segments.src: - **Loan-to-cost (LTC)** — Construction loan amount divided by total project cost; the lender's measure of how much of the budget it's funding, typically 55–65% in recent years.
segments.tr: - **Empréstimo-para-custo (LTC)** — Montante do empréstimo de construção dividido pelo custo total do projeto; a medida do credor de quanto do orçamento está financiando, tipicamente 55–65% nos últimos anos.

segments.src: - **Yield on cost** — Stabilized net operating income divided by total project cost; compared against market cap rates to judge whether building beats buying.
segments.tr: - **Retorno sobre custo** — Renda operacional líquida estabilizada dividida pelo custo total do projeto; comparada com as taxas de capitalização do mercado para julgar se a construção supera a compra.

segments.src: - **Tax increment financing (TIF)** — A public tool that funds project infrastructure by pledging the *future increase* in property tax revenue the project itself is expected to generate.
segments.tr: - **Financiamento por incremento de imposto (TIF)** — Uma ferramenta pública que financia infraestrutura de projeto comprometendo o *aumento futuro* na receita de imposto de propriedade que se espera que o projeto gere.

in.title: [Real Estate 101 #8] Mal Mati di Jalan Raya adalah Teka-Teki $70 Juta — Inilah Cara Pengembang Menyelesaikannya

segments.src: > Development deals come in two flavors by *where* they happen — raw land or an already-built site — and one financing engine that decides whether either flavor ever gets out of the ground.
segments.tr: > Penawaran pengembangan datang dalam dua jenis berdasarkan *di mana* mereka terjadi — tanah mentah atau situs yang sudah dibangun — dan satu mesin pembiayaan yang menentukan apakah salah satu jenis pernah terealisasi.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Konsep Hari Ini

segments.src: When people say "a developer built that," they're compressing three very different jobs into one verb.
segments.tr: Ketika orang mengatakan "pengembang membangun itu," mereka mengompresi tiga pekerjaan yang sangat berbeda menjadi satu kata kerja.

segments.src: **Type 1 — Ground-up on raw or unimproved land.** A farm field at the edge of a growing metro becomes 600 homes, a spine road, sewer lines, and a retail pad.
segments.tr: **Tipe 1 — Pembangunan dari nol di tanah mentah atau tidak ditingkatkan.** Sebuah lahan pertanian di tepi metro yang berkembang menjadi 600 rumah, jalan utama, saluran pembuangan, dan ruang ritel.

segments.src: The technical name is *land development* or *master-planned* development.
segments.tr: Nama teknisnya adalah *pengembangan lahan* atau pengembangan *rencana induk*.

segments.src: The hard part isn't construction; it's **entitlement** — the legal right to build what you want.
segments.tr: Bagian yang sulit bukan konstruksi; itu adalah **entitlement** — hak hukum untuk membangun apa yang Anda inginkan.

segments.src: Rezoning, site plan approval, traffic studies, environmental review, and a string of public hearings where neighbors show up.
segments.tr: Rezoning, persetujuan rencana situs, studi lalu lintas, tinjauan lingkungan, dan serangkaian dengar pendapat publik di mana tetangga hadir.

segments.src: Entitlement can take 18 months to five years and can simply fail.
segments.tr: Entitlement dapat memakan waktu 18 bulan hingga lima tahun dan dapat gagal begitu saja.

segments.src: The reward for surviving it: land that cost $40,000 an acre as pasture is worth several times that the day the zoning changes, before a single shovel moves.
segments.tr: Hadiah untuk bertahan: tanah yang biaya $40,000 per acre sebagai padang rumput bernilai beberapa kali lipat pada hari perubahan zoning, sebelum sekali pun sekop bergerak.

segments.src: **Type 2 — Redevelopment of an already-built site.** The dying mall, the vacant office tower, the aging strip center, the 1960s warehouse.
segments.tr: **Tipe 2 — Pengembangan kembali situs yang sudah dibangun.** Mal yang sekarat, menara kantor kosong, pusat strip yang menua, gudang tahun 1960-an.

segments.src: Here the land already has infrastructure, roads, and usually decent zoning — which is exactly why the site is expensive.
segments.tr: Di sini tanah sudah memiliki infrastruktur, jalan, dan biasanya zoning yang layak — yang justru alasan mengapa situs ini mahal.

segments.src: You're buying a building you may not want, so demolition, asbestos abatement, and environmental cleanup enter the budget.
segments.tr: Anda membeli bangunan yang mungkin tidak Anda inginkan, jadi demolisi, penanggulangan asbestos, dan pembersihan lingkungan masuk ke anggaran.

segments.src: Two sub-flavors matter: **teardown-and-rebuild** (raze it, densify it) and **adaptive reuse** (keep the bones, change the use — a warehouse becomes lofts, a mall becomes a town center).
segments.tr: Dua sub-jenis penting: **pembongkaran-dan-pembangunan kembali** (ratakan, padatkan) dan **penggunaan kembali adaptif** (pertahankan struktur dasarnya, ubah penggunaannya — gudang menjadi loft, mal menjadi pusat kota).

segments.src: Redevelopment also carries a political cost the greenfield deal doesn't: existing tenants, existing neighbors, existing memories.
segments.tr: Pengembangan kembali juga membawa biaya politik yang tidak dimiliki penawaran greenfield: penyewa yang ada, tetangga yang ada, kenangan yang ada.

segments.src: **Type 3 isn't a place — it's a structure.** This is where most beginners get lost.
segments.tr: **Tipe 3 bukan tempat — itu adalah struktur.** Di sini kebanyakan pemula tersesat.

segments.src: *Project finance* means the deal is underwritten against the project's own future cash flow and value, not the developer's balance sheet.
segments.tr: *Pembiayaan proyek* berarti penawaran dijamin terhadap arus kas dan nilai masa depan proyek sendiri, bukan neraca pengembang.

segments.src: It's usually held in a single-purpose entity (an LLC that owns exactly one thing), so a failure is walled off from the sponsor's other deals.
segments.tr: Biasanya dipegang dalam entitas tujuan tunggal (LLC yang memiliki tepat satu hal), jadi kegagalan terisolasi dari penawaran sponsor lainnya.

segments.src: The money arrives in layers — the **capital stack**:
segments.tr: Uang tiba dalam lapisan — **tumpukan modal**:

segments.src: Common equity      (sponsor + investors)  — last paid, highest upside
segments.tr: Common equity      (sponsor + investors)  — last paid, highest upside

segments.src: Preferred / mezz   (11–15% typical)       — fills the gap
segments.tr: Preferred / mezz   (11–15% typical)       — fills the gap

segments.src: Construction loan  (55–65% of cost)       — cheapest, paid first
segments.tr: Construction loan  (55–65% of cost)       — cheapest, paid first

segments.src: The construction loan is the piece people misunderstand most.
segments.tr: Pinjaman konstruksi adalah bagian yang paling sering disalahpahami orang.

segments.src: You don't get a check at closing.
segments.tr: Anda tidak mendapatkan cek saat penutupan.

segments.src: You get a *commitment*, and you draw against it monthly as work is verified — with an interest reserve baked in, because there's no rent yet to pay interest with.
segments.tr: Anda mendapatkan *komitmen*, dan Anda menariknya setiap bulan saat pekerjaan diverifikasi — dengan cadangan bunga tertanam, karena belum ada sewa untuk membayar bunga.

segments.src: It's short (24–36 months), floating-rate, and it must be replaced at the end by a **takeout** (permanent) loan or a sale.
segments.tr: Ini singkat (24–36 bulan), suku bunga mengambang, dan harus diganti di akhir dengan pinjaman **pengambilalihan** (permanen) atau penjualan.

segments.src: That refinancing moment is where a lot of otherwise fine projects died in 2023–2024: costs and rates had moved, and the takeout wouldn't cover the construction loan.
segments.tr: Momen pembiayaan kembali itu adalah tempat banyak proyek yang sebaliknya baik mati pada 2023–2024: biaya dan suku bunga bergerak, dan pengambilalihan tidak akan menutupi pinjaman konstruksi.

segments.src: The number that ties all three together is **yield on cost**: stabilized annual net operating income divided by total project cost.
segments.tr: Angka yang mengikat ketiganya adalah **hasil atas biaya**: pendapatan operasi bersih tahunan yang stabil dibagi dengan total biaya proyek.

segments.src: Developers compare it to the cap rate that finished buildings trade at.
segments.tr: Pengembang membandingkannya dengan tingkat cap di mana bangunan selesai diperdagangkan.

segments.src: If you build to a 6.5% yield on cost in a market where stabilized assets sell at a 5.25% cap rate, that ~125 basis point spread *is* the development profit.
segments.tr: Jika Anda membangun dengan hasil 6,5% atas biaya di pasar di mana aset yang stabil dijual dengan tingkat cap 5,25%, maka spread ~125 basis point *adalah* keuntungan pengembangan.

segments.src: If the spread compresses to zero, the rational move is to buy an existing building instead of building one.
segments.tr: Jika spread menyusut menjadi nol, langkah rasional adalah membeli bangunan yang ada daripada membangun satu.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari

segments.src: Picture a 1972 enclosed mall on 28 acres in a suburb outside Columbus.
segments.tr: Bayangkan mal tertutup tahun 1972 di 28 acre di pinggiran di luar Columbus.

segments.src: Anchor gone, occupancy under 40%, assessed value falling every year — which the city notices, because that's a shrinking tax line.
segments.tr: Penjangkar hilang, okupansi di bawah 40%, nilai penilaian jatuh setiap tahun — yang diperhatikan kota, karena itu adalah garis pajak yang menyusut.

segments.src: A developer options the site for $18 million.
segments.tr: Seorang pengembang mengopsi situs untuk $18 juta.

segments.src: That's Type 2: redevelopment.
segments.tr: Itu adalah Tipe 2: pengembangan kembali.

segments.src: The mall's zoning allows retail but not apartments, so step one is entitlement — a rezoning to mixed use, which takes 14 months and three contentious council meetings.
segments.tr: Zoning mal memungkinkan ritel tetapi bukan apartemen, jadi langkah pertama adalah entitlement — rezoning ke penggunaan campuran, yang membutuhkan 14 bulan dan tiga pertemuan dewan yang kontroversial.

segments.src: Demolition and site prep run $6 million before anything is built.
segments.tr: Demolisi dan persiapan situs biaya $6 juta sebelum apa pun dibangun.

segments.src: Total cost pencils at roughly $70 million for 340 apartments plus 40,000 square feet of ground-floor retail.
segments.tr: Biaya total diperkirakan kira-kira $70 juta untuk 340 apartemen ditambah 40,000 kaki persegi ritel lantai dasar.

segments.src: The capital stack: a $42 million construction loan at 60% loan-to-cost drawn monthly, $12 million of preferred equity, $16 million of common equity from the sponsor and a handful of LPs.
segments.tr: Tumpukan modal: pinjaman konstruksi $42 juta dengan loan-to-cost 60% ditarik setiap bulan, $12 juta ekuitas pilihan, $16 juta ekuitas umum dari sponsor dan segelintir LP.

segments.src: The gap is the public infrastructure — new streets, stormwater, a realigned intersection, roughly $9 million of work no lender wants to finance because it produces no rent.
segments.tr: Celahnya adalah infrastruktur publik — jalan baru, air badai, persimpangan yang selaras kembali, kira-kira $9 juta pekerjaan yang tidak ingin dibiayai oleh pemberi pinjaman karena tidak menghasilkan sewa.

segments.src: So the city creates a **TIF district**: property taxes on the site are frozen at today's depressed level for the taxing bodies, and the *increment* above that — the new taxes generated because the project exists — repays bonds that fund the infrastructure.
segments.tr: Jadi kota menciptakan **distrik TIF**: pajak properti di situs dibekukan pada tingkat tertekan hari ini untuk badan pemungut pajak, dan *kenaikan* di atas itu — pajak baru yang dihasilkan karena proyek ada — mengembalikan obligasi yang mendanai infrastruktur.

segments.src: The city risks future revenue it wouldn't have had otherwise; the developer gets the roads.
segments.tr: Kota mengambil risiko pendapatan masa depan yang tidak akan dimiliki sebaliknya; pengembang mendapatkan jalan.

segments.src: (This is a real trade-off, not free money: if the increment underperforms, someone is on the hook, and school districts often object because their share is frozen too.)
segments.tr: (Ini adalah pertukaran nyata, bukan uang gratis: jika kenaikan kurang baik, seseorang dalam situasi sulit, dan distrik sekolah sering keberatan karena bagian mereka juga dibekukan.)

segments.src: Three years later, stabilized NOI is $4.6 million on $70 million of cost — a 6.6% yield on cost.
segments.tr: Tiga tahun kemudian, NOI yang stabil adalah $4,6 juta pada $70 juta biaya — hasil 6,6% atas biaya.

segments.src: Comparable stabilized apartments in that submarket trade near a 5.4% cap rate, implying a value around $85 million.
segments.tr: Apartemen stabil yang dapat dibandingkan di submarket itu diperdagangkan mendekati tingkat cap 5,4%, menyiratkan nilai sekitar $85 juta.

segments.src: The construction loan is retired with a permanent loan, and the spread between $85 million and $70 million is the return that compensated everyone for four years of risk.
segments.tr: Pinjaman konstruksi pensiun dengan pinjaman permanen, dan spread antara $85 juta dan $70 juta adalah pengembalian yang mengkompensasi semua orang karena empat tahun risiko.

segments.src: Change one input — construction costs up 12%, or rates up 150 basis points — and that spread vanishes.
segments.tr: Ubah satu input — biaya konstruksi naik 12%, atau suku bunga naik 150 basis poin — dan spread itu menghilang.

segments.src: That's why so many announced projects never break ground.
segments.tr: Itu mengapa begitu banyak proyek yang diumumkan tidak pernah dimulai.

ja.title: [不動産 101 #8] 町の衰退したモールは 7000万ドルのパズル — デベロッパーはこう解く

segments.src: > Development deals come in two flavors by *where* they happen — raw land or an already-built site — and one financing engine that decides whether either flavor ever gets out of the ground.
segments.tr: > 開発案件は、*どこで*実施されるかによって2つの形態に分かれます — 未開発地か既存建物のサイト — そして、どちらかが実現するかを決める融資メカニズムが1つあります。

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 本日のコンセプト

segments.src: When people say "a developer built that," they're compressing three very different jobs into one verb.
segments.tr: 人々が「デベロッパーがあれを建てた」と言うとき、全く異なる3つの仕事を1つの動詞に圧縮しているのです。

segments.src: **Type 1 — Ground-up on raw or unimproved land.** A farm field at the edge of a growing metro becomes 600 homes, a spine road, sewer lines, and a retail pad.
segments.tr: **タイプ1 — 未開発地または未改善土地の一から構築。** 成長する都市圏の端にある農地が、600戸の住宅、幹線道路、下水管、小売用地になります。

segments.src: The technical name is *land development* or *master-planned* development.
segments.tr: 技術的には *ランド・デベロップメント* または *マスタープラン開発* と呼ばれます。

segments.src: The hard part isn't construction; it's **entitlement** — the legal right to build what you want.
segments.tr: 難しいのは建設ではなく、**エンタイトルメント** — あなたが望む建物を建設する法的権利です。

segments.src: Rezoning, site plan approval, traffic studies, environmental review, and a string of public hearings where neighbors show up.
segments.tr: 再ゾーニング、サイトプラン承認、交通調査、環境レビュー、近隣住民が参加する一連の公開聴聞会。

segments.src: Entitlement can take 18 months to five years and can simply fail.
segments.tr: エンタイトルメント取得には18ヶ月から5年かかる可能性があり、完全に失敗することもあります。

segments.src: The reward for surviving it: land that cost $40,000 an acre as pasture is worth several times that the day the zoning changes, before a single shovel moves.
segments.tr: それを乗り越えた報酬：牧草地として1エーカー$40,000だった土地は、ゾーニング変更の日には何倍もの価値になります。シャベルが1つ動く前に。

segments.src: **Type 2 — Redevelopment of an already-built site.** The dying mall, the vacant office tower, the aging strip center, the 1960s warehouse.
segments.tr: **タイプ2 — 既存建物のサイトの再開発。** 衰退したモール、空のオフィスタワー、老朽化した商業施設、1960年代の倉庫。

segments.src: Here the land already has infrastructure, roads, and usually decent zoning — which is exactly why the site is expensive.
segments.tr: ここではその土地にすでにインフラ、道路、そして通常はちゃんとしたゾーニングがあります — これがそのサイトが高価な理由です。

segments.src: You're buying a building you may not want, so demolition, asbestos abatement, and environmental cleanup enter the budget.
segments.tr: 欲しくないかもしれない建物を購入する必要があるため、解体、アスベスト除去、環境クリーンアップが予算に含まれます。

segments.src: Two sub-flavors matter: **teardown-and-rebuild** (raze it, densify it) and **adaptive reuse** (keep the bones, change the use — a warehouse becomes lofts, a mall becomes a town center).
segments.tr: 2つのサブタイプが重要です：**解体・再構築** (破壊し、密度を高める) と **適応的再利用** (骨組みを保つ、用途を変更する — 倉庫がロフトになり、モールがタウンセンターになります)。

segments.src: Redevelopment also carries a political cost the greenfield deal doesn't: existing tenants, existing neighbors, existing memories.
segments.tr: 再開発はグリーンフィールド案件にはない政治的コストも伴います：既存のテナント、既存の近隣、既存の思い出。

segments.src: **Type 3 isn't a place — it's a structure.** This is where most beginners get lost.
segments.tr: **タイプ3は場所ではなく — 構造です。** これがほとんどの初心者が迷う場所です。

segments.src: *Project finance* means the deal is underwritten against the project's own future cash flow and value, not the developer's balance sheet.
segments.tr: *プロジェクト・ファイナンス* は、取引がプロジェクト自身の将来のキャッシュフローと価値に基づいて引き受けられることを意味します。デベロッパーのバランスシートではなく。

segments.src: It's usually held in a single-purpose entity (an LLC that owns exactly one thing), so a failure is walled off from the sponsor's other deals.
segments.tr: 通常は単一目的のエンティティ (1つだけを所有するLLC) で保有されているため、失敗はスポンサーの他の案件から隔離されます。

segments.src: The money arrives in layers — the **capital stack**:
segments.tr: お金は層状に到着します — **キャピタルスタック**：

segments.src: Common equity      (sponsor + investors)  — last paid, highest upside
segments.tr: Common equity      (sponsor + investors)  — last paid, highest upside

segments.src: Preferred / mezz   (11–15% typical)       — fills the gap
segments.tr: Preferred / mezz   (11–15% typical)       — fills the gap

segments.src: Construction loan  (55–65% of cost)       — cheapest, paid first
segments.tr: Construction loan  (55–65% of cost)       — cheapest, paid first

segments.src: The construction loan is the piece people misunderstand most.
segments.tr: 建設ローンは人々が最も誤解する部分です。

segments.src: You don't get a check at closing.
segments.tr: クロージング時にチェックをもらいません。

segments.src: You get a *commitment*, and you draw against it monthly as work is verified — with an interest reserve baked in, because there's no rent yet to pay interest with.
segments.tr: あなたは*コミットメント*を得て、作業が検証されるにつれて毎月それに対して引き出します — 利息準備が組み込まれています。まだ家賃の支払いがないからです。

segments.src: It's short (24–36 months), floating-rate, and it must be replaced at the end by a **takeout** (permanent) loan or a sale.
segments.tr: 短期 (24～36ヶ月)、変動金利で、終了時に**テイクアウト** (永久) ローンまたは売却で置き換える必要があります。

segments.src: That refinancing moment is where a lot of otherwise fine projects died in 2023–2024: costs and rates had moved, and the takeout wouldn't cover the construction loan.
segments.tr: その再融資のタイミングが2023～2024年に多くの優良プロジェクトが失敗した場所です：コストとレートが上がり、テイクアウトローンが建設ローンをカバーしていませんでした。

segments.src: The number that ties all three together is **yield on cost**: stabilized annual net operating income divided by total project cost.
segments.tr: 3つを結びつける指標は **利回り** です：安定化した年間純営業利益を総プロジェクトコストで割ったもの。

segments.src: Developers compare it to the cap rate that finished buildings trade at.
segments.tr: デベロッパーはこれを完成建物が取引されるキャップレートと比較します。

segments.src: If you build to a 6.5% yield on cost in a market where stabilized assets sell at a 5.25% cap rate, that ~125 basis point spread *is* the development profit.
segments.tr: 安定化資産が5.25％のキャップレートで売られる市場で、6.5％の利回りで構築する場合、その～125ベーシスポイントのスプレッド *が* 開発利益です。

segments.src: If the spread compresses to zero, the rational move is to buy an existing building instead of building one.
segments.tr: スプレッドがゼロに圧縮されると、1つを建設する代わりに既存建物を購入するのが合理的です。

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 日常生活で

segments.src: Picture a 1972 enclosed mall on 28 acres in a suburb outside Columbus.
segments.tr: コロンバス郊外にある28エーカーの1972年建設の屋内モールを想像してください。

segments.src: Anchor gone, occupancy under 40%, assessed value falling every year — which the city notices, because that's a shrinking tax line.
segments.tr: アンカーテナント消失、入居率40％未満、評価額毎年低下 — 都市はそれに気付きます。税収ラインが縮小しているからです。

segments.src: A developer options the site for $18 million.
segments.tr: デベロッパーがそのサイトを$18ミリオンでオプションします。

segments.src: That's Type 2: redevelopment.
segments.tr: これはタイプ2：再開発です。

segments.src: The mall's zoning allows retail but not apartments, so step one is entitlement — a rezoning to mixed use, which takes 14 months and three contentious council meetings.
segments.tr: モールのゾーニングは小売を許可していますがアパートは許可していないため、最初のステップはエンタイトルメント — 混合用途への再ゾーニング。14ヶ月と3回の論争的な市議会会議がかかります。

segments.src: Demolition and site prep run $6 million before anything is built.
segments.tr: 何かが構築される前に、解体とサイト準備で$6ミリオンがかかります。

segments.src: Total cost pencils at roughly $70 million for 340 apartments plus 40,000 square feet of ground-floor retail.
segments.tr: 総開発コストはおよそ$70ミリオン — 340戸のアパートと40,000平方フィートの1階小売スペース。

segments.src: The capital stack: a $42 million construction loan at 60% loan-to-cost drawn monthly, $12 million of preferred equity, $16 million of common equity from the sponsor and a handful of LPs.
segments.tr: キャピタルスタック：毎月引き出される60％ローン・トゥ・コスト比の$42ミリオン建設ローン、$12ミリオンの優先株、スポンサーと何人かのLPからの$16ミリオン普通株。

segments.src: The gap is the public infrastructure — new streets, stormwater, a realigned intersection, roughly $9 million of work no lender wants to finance because it produces no rent.
segments.tr: ギャップは公共インフラ — 新しい街路、雨水排水、交差点再配置、大体$9ミリオンの工事。貸し手は誰も融資したくありません。賃料を生まないからです。

segments.src: So the city creates a **TIF district**: property taxes on the site are frozen at today's depressed level for the taxing bodies, and the *increment* above that — the new taxes generated because the project exists — repays bonds that fund the infrastructure.
segments.tr: そこで都市は**TIF地区**を作成します：そのサイトの固定資産税は課税機関について現在の抑制水準で凍結され、それを超える*増分* — プロジェクトが存在するため発生する新しい税収 — インフラ資金化債券を返済します。

segments.src: The city risks future revenue it wouldn't have had otherwise; the developer gets the roads.
segments.tr: 都市はそうでなければ得られなかったであろう将来の税収をリスクにさらします；デベロッパーは道路を取得します。

segments.src: (This is a real trade-off, not free money: if the increment underperforms, someone is on the hook, and school districts often object because their share is frozen too.)
segments.tr: (これは本当のトレードオフです。無料のお金ではありません。増分がパフォーマンスを下回る場合、誰かが責任を負い、学区はその取り分も凍結されているため異議を唱えることが多いです。)

segments.src: Three years later, stabilized NOI is $4.6 million on $70 million of cost — a 6.6% yield on cost.
segments.tr: 3年後、安定化NOIは$70ミリオンのコストで$4.6ミリオン — 6.6％の利回り。

segments.src: Comparable stabilized apartments in that submarket trade near a 5.4% cap rate, implying a value around $85 million.
segments.tr: その部分市場の比較可能な安定化アパートは5.4％のキャップレート付近で取引され、約$85ミリオンの価値を暗示しています。

segments.src: The construction loan is retired with a permanent loan, and the spread between $85 million and $70 million is the return that compensated everyone for four years of risk.
segments.tr: 建設ローンはパーマネントローンで完済され、$85ミリオンと$70ミリオンの間のスプレッドが4年間のリスク負担に対する全員への報酬です。

segments.src: Change one input — construction costs up 12%, or rates up 150 basis points — and that spread vanishes.
segments.tr: 1つのインプットを変更 — 建設コスト12％上昇、またはレート150ベーシスポイント上昇 — そのスプレッドは消えます。

segments.src: That's why so many announced projects never break ground.
segments.tr: だからこそ、発表された多くのプロジェクトが着工しません。

segments.src: ## 3-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## 3行要約

segments.src: 1. Development sites come in two kinds: raw land (where entitlement risk dominates) and already-built sites (where acquisition cost, demolition, and politics dominate).
segments.tr: 1. 開発サイトは2種類：未開発地 (エンタイトルメントリスクが支配的) と既存建物のサイト (取得費、解体、政治が支配的)。

segments.src: 2. Project finance is the engine — a single-purpose entity, a layered capital stack, and a draw-based construction loan that must be replaced by a takeout loan or a sale.
segments.tr: 2. プロジェクト・ファイナンスがエンジン — 単一目的エンティティ、階層化したキャピタルスタック、そしてテイクアウトローンまたは売却で置き換える必要がある引き出しベース建設ローン。

segments.src: 3. The deal only works if yield on cost clears the market cap rate by a meaningful spread; when that spread compresses, building stops even where demand is obvious.
segments.tr: 3. 取引は利回りが意味のあるスプレッド分、マーケットキャップレートを上回る場合にのみ成立します；そのスプレッドが圧縮されると、需要が明らかな場所でも建設は止まります。

segments.src: ## ✅ Self Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ セルフクイズ

segments.src: (O/X)** A construction loan is funded in full at closing, and the developer holds the cash until it's needed.
segments.tr: (○/×)** 建設ローンはクロージング時に全額が融資され、デベロッパーは必要になるまで現金を保有しています。

segments.src: **2.** "Entitlement" in development most nearly means:
segments.tr: **2.** 開発における「エンタイトルメント」は最も近くは以下の意味です：

segments.src: - (a) Signing the purchase contract for the land
segments.tr: - (a) 土地の購入契約に署名する

segments.src: - (b) Securing the legal right to build the use and density you want
segments.tr: - (b) 希望する用途と密度で建設する法的権利を確保する

segments.src: - (c) Hiring the general contractor
segments.tr: - (c) ゼネラルコントラクターを雇用する

segments.src: - (d) Locking the permanent loan rate
segments.tr: - (d) パーマネントローン金利をロックする

segments.src: **3.** A project underwrites to a 6.5% yield on cost, while similar finished buildings in that market trade at a 5.25% cap rate.
segments.tr: **3.** プロジェクトが6.5％の利回りで引き受けられ、その市場の同様の完成建物は5.25％のキャップレートで取引されます。

segments.src: This gap primarily represents:
segments.tr: このギャップは主に以下を表しています：

segments.src: - (a) The developer's compensation for taking construction and lease-up risk
segments.tr: - (a) 建設およびリース・アップリスク負担に対するデベロッパーの報酬

segments.src: - (b) The interest rate on the construction loan
segments.tr: - (b) 建設ローンの金利

segments.src: - (c) The property tax rate
segments.tr: - (c) 固定資産税率

segments.src: - (d) An error — the two numbers should always match
segments.tr: - (d) 誤り — 2つの数字は常に一致するはずです

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 本日の用語

segments.src: - **Entitlement** — The bundle of government approvals (zoning, site plan, permits) that make a specific project legally buildable on a specific site.
segments.tr: - **エンタイトルメント** — 特定のプロジェクトを特定のサイトで法的に建設可能にするための政府承認 (ゾーニング、サイトプラン、許可) の一式。

segments.src: - **Capital stack** — The layered ordering of money in a deal, from senior debt (paid first, lowest return) up to common equity (paid last, highest upside).
segments.tr: - **キャピタルスタック** — 取引における資金の階層的配列。シニア債務 (最初に支払われ、最低リターン) からコモンエクイティ (最後に支払われ、最高のアップサイド) まで。

segments.src: - **Loan-to-cost (LTC)** — Construction loan amount divided by total project cost; the lender's measure of how much of the budget it's funding, typically 55–65% in recent years.
segments.tr: - **ローン・トゥ・コスト (LTC)** — 建設ローン額を総プロジェクトコストで割ったもの；貸し手がいくらの予算を融資しているかの尺度。近年は一般的に55～65％。

segments.src: - **Yield on cost** — Stabilized net operating income divided by total project cost; compared against market cap rates to judge whether building beats buying.
segments.tr: - **利回り** — 安定化した純営業利益を総プロジェクトコストで割ったもの；建設が購入より有利かを判断するためマーケットキャップレートと比較されます。

segments.src: - **Tax increment financing (TIF)** — A public tool that funds project infrastructure by pledging the *future increase* in property tax revenue the project itself is expected to generate.
segments.tr: - **税増分融資 (TIF)** — プロジェクト自体が生み出すことが期待される固定資産税収入の*将来増分*を担保にしてプロジェクトインフラを資金化する公的ツール。

segments.src: Entitlement can take 18 months to five years and can simply fail.
segments.tr: Genehmigungsrecht kann 18 Monate bis fünf Jahre dauern und kann einfach scheitern.

segments.src: The reward for surviving it: land that cost $40,000 an acre as pasture is worth several times that the day the zoning changes, before a single shovel moves.
segments.tr: Die Belohnung für das Überstehen: Land, das $40.000 pro Acre als Weideland kostete, ist am Tag der Umzonung mehrmals so viel wert, bevor ein Bagger anrückt.

segments.src: **Type 2 — Redevelopment of an already-built site.** The dying mall, the vacant office tower, the aging strip center, the 1960s warehouse.
segments.tr: **Typ 2 — Umnutzung eines bereits bebauten Grundstücks.** Das sterbende Einkaufszentrum, das leer stehende Bürogebäude, das alternde Ladenstreifen-Center, das Lagerhaus aus den 1960er Jahren.

segments.src: Here the land already has infrastructure, roads, and usually decent zoning — which is exactly why the site is expensive.
segments.tr: Hier hat das Land bereits Infrastruktur, Straßen und meist gute Zonierung — genau das ist der Grund, warum das Grundstück teuer ist.

segments.src: You're buying a building you may not want, so demolition, asbestos abatement, and environmental cleanup enter the budget.
segments.tr: Sie kaufen ein Gebäude, das Sie möglicherweise nicht wollen, also kommen Abriss, Asbestabtragung und Umweltsanierung in den Kostenrahmen.

segments.src: Two sub-flavors matter: **teardown-and-rebuild** (raze it, densify it) and **adaptive reuse** (keep the bones, change the use — a warehouse becomes lofts, a mall becomes a town center).
segments.tr: Zwei Untervarianten sind wichtig: **Abriss-und-Neubau** (niederreißen, verdichten) und **adaptive Nutzung** (Struktur behalten, Nutzung ändern — ein Lagerhaus wird zu Lofts, ein Einkaufszentrum wird zu einem Town Center).

segments.src: Redevelopment also carries a political cost the greenfield deal doesn't: existing tenants, existing neighbors, existing memories.
segments.tr: Umnutzung trägt auch politische Kosten, die das Greenfield-Projekt nicht hat: bestehende Mieter, bestehende Nachbarn, bestehende Erinnerungen.

segments.src: **Type 3 isn't a place — it's a structure.** This is where most beginners get lost.
segments.tr: **Typ 3 ist kein Ort — es ist eine Struktur.** Hier verlaufen sich die meisten Anfänger.

segments.src: *Project finance* means the deal is underwritten against the project's own future cash flow and value, not the developer's balance sheet.
segments.tr: *Projektfinanzierung* bedeutet, dass der Deal gegen die eigenen zukünftigen Cashflows und Werte des Projekts abgesichert ist, nicht gegen die Bilanz des Entwicklers.

segments.src: It's usually held in a single-purpose entity (an LLC that owns exactly one thing), so a failure is walled off from the sponsor's other deals.
segments.tr: Es wird üblicherweise in einer Single-Purpose-Entity gehalten (ein LLC, das genau eine Sache besitzt), sodass ein Ausfall vom Sponsor's anderen Deals isoliert ist.

segments.src: The money arrives in layers — the **capital stack**:
segments.tr: Das Geld kommt in Schichten — der **Kapitalstruktur**:

segments.src: Common equity      (sponsor + investors)  — last paid, highest upside
segments.tr: Common equity      (sponsor + investors)  — last paid, highest upside

segments.src: Preferred / mezz   (11–15% typical)       — fills the gap
segments.tr: Preferred / mezz   (11–15% typical)       — fills the gap

segments.src: Construction loan  (55–65% of cost)       — cheapest, paid first
segments.tr: Construction loan  (55–65% of cost)       — cheapest, paid first

segments.src: The construction loan is the piece people misunderstand most.
segments.tr: Das Baudarlehen ist das Stück, das Menschen am meisten missverstehen.

segments.src: You don't get a check at closing.
segments.tr: Sie erhalten keinen Scheck beim Closing.

segments.src: You get a *commitment*, and you draw against it monthly as work is verified — with an interest reserve baked in, because there's no rent yet to pay interest with.
segments.tr: Sie erhalten eine *Zusage*, und Sie rufen monatlich gegen sie ab, wenn die Arbeiten überprüft und verifiziert werden — mit einer Zinsrücklage, denn es gibt noch keine Miete zur Bezahlung der Zinsen.

segments.src: It's short (24–36 months), floating-rate, and it must be replaced at the end by a **takeout** (permanent) loan or a sale.
segments.tr: Es ist kurz (24–36 Monate), mit schwankendem Satz, und es muss am Ende durch ein **Nachfolgedarlehen** (Dauerdarlehen) oder einen Verkauf ersetzt werden.

segments.src: That refinancing moment is where a lot of otherwise fine projects died in 2023–2024: costs and rates had moved, and the takeout wouldn't cover the construction loan.
segments.tr: Dieser Refinanzierungsmoment ist der Punkt, an dem 2023–2024 viele ansonsten gute Projekte starben: Kosten und Sätze waren gestiegen, und das Nachfolgedarlehen würde das Baudarlehen nicht decken.

segments.src: The number that ties all three together is **yield on cost**: stabilized annual net operating income divided by total project cost.
segments.tr: Die Zahl, die alle drei zusammenbindet, ist **Rendite auf Kosten**: Stabilisiertes jährliches Netto-Betriebseinkommen dividiert durch Gesamtprojektkosten.

segments.src: Developers compare it to the cap rate that finished buildings trade at.
segments.tr: Entwickler vergleichen es mit der Kapitalisierungsrate, mit der fertiggestellte Gebäude gehandelt werden.

segments.src: If you build to a 6.5% yield on cost in a market where stabilized assets sell at a 5.25% cap rate, that ~125 basis point spread *is* the development profit.
segments.tr: Wenn Sie zu einer 6,5%-Rendite auf Kosten bauen, in einem Markt, in dem stabilisierte Vermögenswerte mit einer 5,25%-Kapitalisierungsrate verkauft werden, dann ist diese ~125-Basis-Punkt-Spanne *der* Entwicklungsgewinn.

segments.src: If the spread compresses to zero, the rational move is to buy an existing building instead of building one.
segments.tr: Wenn die Spanne gegen Null schrumpft, ist der rationale Schritt, ein bestehendes Gebäude zu kaufen, anstatt ein zu bauen.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Im Alltag

segments.src: Picture a 1972 enclosed mall on 28 acres in a suburb outside Columbus.
segments.tr: Stellen Sie sich ein geschlossenes Einkaufszentrum von 1972 auf 28 Acres in einem Vorort außerhalb von Columbus vor.

segments.src: Anchor gone, occupancy under 40%, assessed value falling every year — which the city notices, because that's a shrinking tax line.
segments.tr: Ankermieter weg, Auslastung unter 40%, Steuerwert fällt jedes Jahr — was die Stadt bemerkt, denn das ist eine schrumpfende Steuerlinie.

segments.src: A developer options the site for $18 million.
segments.tr: Ein Entwickler sichert sich das Gelände für $18 Millionen.

segments.src: That's Type 2: redevelopment.
segments.tr: Das ist Typ 2: Umnutzung.

segments.src: The mall's zoning allows retail but not apartments, so step one is entitlement — a rezoning to mixed use, which takes 14 months and three contentious council meetings.
segments.tr: Die Zonierung des Einkaufszentrums ermöglicht den Einzelhandel, aber keine Apartments, also ist Schritt eins das Genehmigungsrecht — eine Umzonung auf Mischnutzung, die 14 Monate und drei umstrittene Ratssitzungen dauert.

segments.src: Demolition and site prep run $6 million before anything is built.
segments.tr: Abriss und Grundstücksvorbereitung kosten $6 Millionen, bevor irgendetwas gebaut wird.

segments.src: Total cost pencils at roughly $70 million for 340 apartments plus 40,000 square feet of ground-floor retail.
segments.tr: Gesamtkosten: ungefähr $70 Millionen für 340 Apartments plus 40.000 Quadratmeter Einzelhandelsfläche im Erdgeschoss.

segments.src: The capital stack: a $42 million construction loan at 60% loan-to-cost drawn monthly, $12 million of preferred equity, $16 million of common equity from the sponsor and a handful of LPs.
segments.tr: Die Kapitalstruktur: ein $42 Millionen Baudarlehen bei 60% Darlehensquote monatlich abgerufen, $12 Millionen Vorzugskapital, $16 Millionen gemeinsames Kapital vom Sponsor und einer Handvoll LP.

segments.src: The gap is the public infrastructure — new streets, stormwater, a realigned intersection, roughly $9 million of work no lender wants to finance because it produces no rent.
segments.tr: Die Lücke ist die öffentliche Infrastruktur — neue Straßen, Regenwassermanagement, eine versetzte Kreuzung, ungefähr $9 Millionen Arbeit, die kein Kreditgeber finanzieren möchte, weil sie keine Miete einbringt.

segments.src: So the city creates a **TIF district**: property taxes on the site are frozen at today's depressed level for the taxing bodies, and the *increment* above that — the new taxes generated because the project exists — repays bonds that fund the infrastructure.
segments.tr: Also erstellt die Stadt einen **TIF-Bezirk**: Grundsteuern auf dem Gelände werden auf dem heutigen deprimierten Niveau für die Steuerbehörden eingefroren, und das *Increment* — die neuen Steuern, die wegen des Projekts generiert werden — zahlt Anleihen zurück, die die Infrastruktur finanzieren.

segments.src: The city risks future revenue it wouldn't have had otherwise; the developer gets the roads.
segments.tr: Die Stadt riskiert zukünftige Einnahmen, die sie sonst nicht hätte; der Entwickler bekommt die Straßen.

segments.src: (This is a real trade-off, not free money: if the increment underperforms, someone is on the hook, and school districts often object because their share is frozen too.)
segments.tr: (Das ist ein echtes Handelsgeschäft, kein kostenloses Geld: wenn das Increment unterdurchschnittlich abschneidet, sitzt jemand auf der Liabilität, und Schulbezirke argumentieren oft dagegen, weil ihre Quote auch eingefroren ist.)

segments.src: Three years later, stabilized NOI is $4.6 million on $70 million of cost — a 6.6% yield on cost.
segments.tr: Drei Jahre später: stabilisiertes Netto-Betriebseinkommen von $4,6 Millionen auf $70 Millionen Kosten — eine 6,6%-Rendite auf Kosten.

segments.src: Comparable stabilized apartments in that submarket trade near a 5.4% cap rate, implying a value around $85 million.
segments.tr: Vergleichbare stabilisierte Apartments in diesem Submarkt werden um eine 5,4%-Kapitalisierungsrate gehandelt, was einen Wert von ungefähr $85 Millionen impliziert.

segments.src: The construction loan is retired with a permanent loan, and the spread between $85 million and $70 million is the return that compensated everyone for four years of risk.
segments.tr: Das Baudarlehen wird mit einem Dauerdarlehen abgelöst, und die Spanne zwischen $85 Millionen und $70 Millionen ist die Rendite, die alle für vier Jahre Risiko kompensierte.

segments.src: Change one input — construction costs up 12%, or rates up 150 basis points — and that spread vanishes.
segments.tr: Ändern Sie einen Eingabeparameter — Konstruktionskosten um 12% höher oder Sätze um 150 Basis-Punkte höher — und diese Spanne verschwindet.

segments.src: That's why so many announced projects never break ground.
segments.tr: Das ist, warum so viele angekündigte Projekte nie Grundlagen legen.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Recap
segments.tr: ## 3-Zeilen-Zusammenfassung

segments.src: 1. Development sites come in two kinds: raw land (where entitlement risk dominates) and already-built sites (where acquisition cost, demolition, and politics dominate).
segments.tr: 1. Entwicklungsgelände gibt es in zwei Arten: Rohland (wo Genehmigungsrisiko dominiert) und bereits bebaute Gelände (wo Akquisitionskosten, Abriss und Politik dominieren).

segments.src: 2. Project finance is the engine — a single-purpose entity, a layered capital stack, and a draw-based construction loan that must be replaced by a takeout loan or a sale.
segments.tr: 2. Projektfinanzierung ist das Rückgrat — eine Single-Purpose-Entity, eine geschichtete Kapitalstruktur und ein abrufbasiertes Baudarlehen, das durch ein Nachfolgedarlehen oder einen Verkauf ersetzt werden muss.

segments.src: 3. The deal only works if yield on cost clears the market cap rate by a meaningful spread; when that spread compresses, building stops even where demand is obvious.
segments.tr: 3. Der Deal funktioniert nur, wenn die Rendite auf Kosten die Markt-Kapitalisierungsrate um einen bedeutsamen Spread übersteigt; wenn diese Spanne schrumpft, stoppt das Bauen selbst dort, wo die Nachfrage offensichtlich ist.

segments.tr: Diese Lücke repräsentiert hauptsächlich:

segments.src: - (a) The developer's compensation for taking construction and lease-up risk
segments.tr: - (a) Die Vergütung des Entwicklers für die Übernahme von Konstruktions- und Vermietungsrisiken
